channels.name: Firefox Add-ons
channels.instructions: These XPI files are unsigned and need AMO signing/review. They use new IDs living-code-{night,paper}@living-code-theme and author Living Code. Existing public themes use @elliotluque: these new IDs cannot update those installations. Decide on clean new listings versus retaining old GUIDs before submission. Submit each flavor separately and update source/support links to the organization.
